items.title_en: 20-Year-Old Man Cleans Polluted River With His Bare Hands, Internet Asks 'Where Is The Municipality?'
items.title_zh: 20岁男子徒手清理污染河流，网友问“市政府在哪里？”
items.summary_en: Bittu Tabahi, a 20-year-old from Madhya Pradesh, has spent months removing plastic and waste from the polluted Ajnar River using his own hands and money.
items.summary_zh: 来自中央邦的 20 岁比特图·塔巴希 (Bittu Tabahi) 花了几个月的时间，用自己的双手和金钱清除了受污染的阿杰纳尔河 (Ajnar River) 中的塑料和废物。
